interface.title: Ancient DNA Analyzer (v2.0, 'AI-Powered Paleogenomics Toolkit')
interface.stage_of_work: Exploratory first look at short DNA fragments after sequencing, before alignment or BLAST
interface.what_it_is_for: Paste or upload short DNA sequences and get base composition, GC, ORF, restriction-site, codon-usage, translation and unaligned position-by-position mutation summaries, plus an optional narrative report.

data.note: First used the built-in 'Load Demo Data' (Neanderthal_mtDNA 422 bp, Mammoth_CYTB 360 bp). It only lasts for one page refresh: the next widget change or page switch empties it (screens/011.webp, screens/014.webp). Most of the work used sample_sequences.fasta (4 records: Neanderthal HVR1 422 bp, Mammoth CYTB 360 bp, Denisovan FOXP2 311 bp, Cave Bear COX1 366 bp) and variant_mtDNA.fasta (Neanderthal_mtDNA_Variant 422 bp, Sequence_With_Ambiguous_Base). I also pasted a 720 bp GFP-like coding sequence named Test_Gene_ORF, and an invalid string to test the input check.

tree.general: Characterise short DNA sequences and compare them with each other
tree.specific: Profile short DNA fragments (the demo data are ancient-DNA samples; the tool does no aDNA-specific authentication, damage or alignment work): composition, GC, ORFs, restriction sites, codons, translations, and an unaligned tally of point differences between two fragments

screens_never_reached: A real Ollama-generated narrative on AI Insights: Ollama is not available in this sandbox, so only the rule-based fallback report appeared (screens/038.webp)
Genome Engineering or AI Insights for any sequence other than the first one loaded: neither page has a sequence selector, and Genome Engineering always shows 'Analyzing: <first sequence>'
not_done: Left out of the tree on purpose: exporting results (table CSV, plot PNG) and the command-line interface the README lists (cli.py analyze --report, cli.py compare). Export was tried once with no visible download (below); the CLI is outside this browser run.

Did not compare the original Neanderthal HVR1 with Neanderthal_mtDNA_Variant. The uploader keeps one file at a time (adding variant_mtDNA.fasta replaced sample_sequences.fasta), Paste mode holds a single sequence, and switching Paste/Upload clears the other's data, so the two files cannot be loaded together. Instead I compared Variant vs Sequence_With_Ambiguous_Base, Neanderthal vs Mammoth, and Denisovan vs Cave Bear.

Did not check how the 'N' in Sequence_With_Ambiguous_Base is counted in the comparison. Searching the Mutation Details table for 'N' does not answer this: it matches the type text of every row, and the table shows only the first 50 of 190 mutations.
Mutation Details table search count: the replay's search for 'transi' reported 12 results against 60 transitions; the 50-row cap and rows-in-view counting may explain it, but this was not checked.
CSV download from the Sliding Window GC table: I pressed the download icon but nothing appeared in the browser's downloads list (screens/007.webp). I did not try plot PNG downloads.

Demo data persistence: Load Demo Data only lasts for one page refresh. Switching pages or changing any widget (for example the Reading Frame) empties the loaded set (screens/011.webp, screens/014.webp), so demo-based work has to be redone on each page.

Possible stale state in Codon Analysis: right after the upload the selector read 'Frame 1' with bias score 1.78 (screens/015.webp), and switching to Frame 2 kept 1.78 (screens/017.webp). Later, Frame 1 on the same file drew a different chart (screens/050.webp) and Frame 3 gave 1.55 (screens/051.webp). The first Frame 1 view may have been carrying over an earlier selection.
Did not check whether pasting multi-record FASTA text (with '>' headers) into the DNA Sequence box is parsed. It would probably fail the strict ACGT check.
The restriction map for the pasted GFP-like sequence did not report a site for the GCTAGC motif (NheI) near its start. NheI may not be in the tool's enzyme list; I did not confirm this.
